\section{Results}
The expected loss is bounded as follows
\[\label{eq:bound}
\begin{align}
\E[\ell] &\le \sum_k \vect{w}_k \label{eq:first} \\
&= 1
\end{align}\]
where $\vect{w}$ are the weights, as shown in Fig.~\ref{fig:acc}.
